description: Excel accent weight of long runs of one combining mark (T-3201): Data!A1:A246 is a ladder of "a" plus up to three marks other than U+0300, U+0301, U+030A, U+0323 and U+0342, one per diacritic weight 2, 5, 8, 11 and 14 to 255 by the Windows table (Calc!A = count of ladder entries less than it); Data!B holds "a" with 1 to 40 of U+0301, U+030A, U+0323, U+0342 (B1:B160), two-mark mixes and other runs (B161:B180), "e" with 1 to 40 acutes ranked against the ladder after e (B181:B220) and "a", 1 to 40 acutes, "b" ranked against the ladder followed by b (B221:B260); Calc!B = count of ladder entries less, Calc!C = count equal, Calc!D = (x<y)+2*(x=y)+4*(x>y) against the row above (n against n-1).
